rules: Session touch alone never confirms a setup.
Sweep and reclaim must be separated from break and acceptance.
Direction requires HTF context, session interaction, displacement and CRT confirmation.
Session is confluence, not a universal hard veto.
Crypto session timing is context only.
SMT is a quality factor, not a hard gate.
A confirmed setup must reference deterministic event ids.
Old session ranges expire at the next same-session occurrence.
